item.title: Editorial: Gloomy forecasts should shape the budget debate in Richmond
item.description: It’s critical that the state budget responsibly insulates the commonwealth from continued economic turmoil.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for March 01, 2026
item.description: The process of healing can genuinely make us stronger. While the Moon trines vigilant Chiron at 9:08 pm EST, we'll probably find it easier to share and repair feelings with care. Everyone's hearts are closer to the surface than usual, so being tolerant of one another's idiosyncrasies could be necessary to avoid strife. item.title: Over 150 gather in downtown Norfolk to protest ICE, call for veterans support
item.description: Over 150 gathered in downtown Norfolk on Saturday afternoon to demonstrate against federal immigration enforcement efforts that have led to the deaths of several U.S. and non citizens since the year began, and to call for protections of veterans' rights.

item.title: Regent gains first baseball victory in school history
item.description: The Royals routed Valley Forge in a doubleheader opener in Game 1, though they lost a Game 2 cliffhanger.

item.title: Chase Lowe scores 1,000th W&M point as Tribe hold on for wild win at NC A&T
item.description: A&T lost despite shooting 64% (35 of 55) from the field. W&M hit half of its shots and committed just five turnovers.

item.title: Admirals switch goalies, win at Greensboro despite losing series
item.description: Goaltender Christian Propp made 14 saves in 40 minutes of shutout relief, and Kristof Papp had a goal and two assists.

item.title: Coach guides Norfolk State women past former team; CNU women take another C2C title
item.description: Jermaine Woods enjoyed a happy return to Baltimore, and the Captains increased their conference tournament title streak to seven seasons as they await their NCAA Division III pairing.

item.title: Norfolk State men boost winning streak to five by turning back Coppin State
item.description: Anthony McComb III led Norfolk State with 22 points, and the Spartans stayed one game off Howard's MEAC lead.

item.title: Virginia Tech can’t pull upset at No. 18 North Carolina
item.description: The Hokies lost to the Caleb Wilson-less Tar Heels despite 19 points from Neo Avdalas and 16 apiece from Tobi Lawal and Ben Hammond.
